NBC/Peacock will broadcast 100 regular-season games, approximately 28 gamesin the first two rounds of the playoffs and one of the conference finals in six of the 11 years, while also becoming the new home of NBA All-Star weekend.Prime Video - A brand new partner for the NBA, Prime will broadcast select regular-season games, including the Knockout Rounds of the Emirates NBA Cupbefore the Championship Game of the third-annual in-season competition on Dec. 16.
